description:
ERECTION OF A SINGLE STOREY OUTBUILDING IN REAR
GARDEN FOR INCIDENTAL USE
decision_conditions:
<p><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;
font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:Aptos;mso-fareast-theme-font:
minor-latin;mso-ansi-language:EN-GB;mso-fareast-language:EN-US;mso-bidi-language:
AR-SA">The development hereby permitted shall not be rented, sold independently
or occupied at any time other than for purposes incidental to the main
residential use of the dwelling known as&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">21 Worcester Close,
Mitcham, Surrey, Merton, CR4 1SQ.</span></p><p><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;
font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:Aptos;mso-fareast-theme-font:
minor-latin;mso-ansi-language:EN-GB;mso-fareast-language:EN-US;mso-bidi-language:
AR-SA"><br></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;line-height:normal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">Reason:&nbsp; To safeguard the amenities of neighbouring
residents, to prevent the unauthorised introduction of an independent use and
to ensure compliance with the following Development Plan policies for Merton:
policies D3 and D4 of the London Plan 2021 and policies D12.1 &amp; D12.3 of
the Local Plan 2024.<o:p></o:p></span></p>
